title: Status line updates never reach a computer installed before version numbers
summary: A status line copy whose stamp still held a pre-version commit time was never offered or merged again; a stamp of 1000000000 or more now counts as version 0, so the normal offer and merge run. One new suite check, version 3 to 4.
friction: The decision recorded on the issue ('larger than ORION_VERSION') would have broken 'never step back', because an installed copy only knows its own project's number; the dev agent caught it and the orchestrator amended the decision mid-run. A stamp rule should be checked against the multi-project case before it is written as a decision.
lessons_learned: The pull request that moved the status line stamp to version numbers shipped no handling for stamps already on disk; a change to a stored format needs a check for what existing installs hold.
